# Community Code of Conduct

## Our Standards
We are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for all contributors and users of KanhaMusic, regardless of experience level, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, personal appearance, race, ethnicity, age, or religion.

## Responsibilities
Community members and maintainers agree to:
- Be respectful and courteous in communication
- Accept constructive criticism gracefully
- Focus on what is best for the community and project

## Enforcement
Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project maintainers at [@MeowClone](https://t.me/MeowClone).
